changelog: Bug fix (thanks for the report): the beep that kept repeating while you record is gone. The speech service beeped at every automatic restart — now auto-restarts are silent, and if Sound FX is off in Settings the whole recording is silent. Soft speech also works better: the recognizer now waits a full 6 seconds before deciding you have stopped, so quietly spoken words are no longer cut off mid-sentence, and the “nothing heard” hint only appears after 15 seconds of real silence — never while you are speaking softly.
